reviewPolicy.sourcePolicy: Use Product Code Data Segment field 8's R marker for required presence; use the explicit 0.059/three-assumed-decimal example only as a source-backed populated-value design.
reviewPolicy.dataPolicy: Presence-focused field design only. Do not infer all Unit Price values use three decimal places; the decimal count and product context are explicit per vector.
reviewPolicy.baselinePolicy: References the Segment 102 source field table and existing SEG102-R-013 format rule; adds a review-only presence component, not an official rule.
reviewPolicy.promotionGate: Authorized Test review must confirm a valid complete Product Code Data Segment request, contextual decimal places, omission handling, and readiness before promotion or execution.

requirementReferences.title: Product Code Data Segment field 8 / Element 107 Unit Price is required when the segment's product record is present.
Unit Price preserves the assumed-decimal-place leading digit

sourceEvidence.quote: 8 107 Unit Price 9 R Identifies the price per unit of measure for the product sold.
sourceEvidence.interpretation: Segment 102 Product Code Data field 8 / Element 107 is marked Required (R).

sourceEvidence.quote: Example: If the unit price is $0.059 and the number of assumed decimal places is 3, then this should be represented as ‘3059’. ‘359’ will be considered invalid.
sourceEvidence.interpretation: For the positive presence design, the source explicitly supplies Unit Price value 3059 for $0.059 with three assumed decimal places. This is an example context, not a universal decimal rule.

aiReviewReferences.observations: All eight candidate payloads bind Segment 102 Element 107 Unit Price; four are declared omissions and four have exact value 000. Each candidate case has two hash-identical catalog-copy observations. These are producer candidate records, not independent Test results.
aiReviewReferences.interpretation: The AI chain supplies preliminary producer-side presence/omission variation. Its values do not exercise the cited decimal example; no semantic match or expected response is approved.

testScenarios.intent: For a reviewed-valid Segment 102 product record using the source's 0.059/three-assumed-decimal example, include Element 107 Unit Price and compare with a field-omission mutation.

testCases.assertion: Unit Price Element 107 is present with the source example value 3059 for $0.059 at three assumed decimal places.
Unit Price Element 107 is omitted from the otherwise reviewed-valid Segment 102 product record.

openQuestions: Confirm the complete product-code segment and unit-of-measure context for the 0.059 Unit Price example.
Confirm required companion fields and field separators for a complete executable Segment 102 request.
Confirm expected structural handling for an omitted required Unit Price; no host response is inferred.
Keep the separate Unit Price decimal-format rule SEG102-R-013 under its own review; this draft addresses presence only.
